label: OBJECTIVELY_TRUE_1: ObjectiveTruth φ: φ is true independently of anyone's attitudes or conventions
definition: `ObjectiveTruth φ`: φ is true independently of anyone's attitudes or conventions.
note: The linked projection is the primitive ObjectiveTruth field of the existing comparison signature; the source readings likewise take an independently supplied predicate. It is not a definition reducing the predicate to a truth/attitude criterion. Source claims and that predicate remain unchanged. Analyst profile calibrations and the weakest objective-implies-truth proposition are recorded separately in DISAMB-OBJECTIVE-TRUTH-CALIBRATIONS; none is silently attributed to these sources or adopted as every philosophical sense of objectivity.

formal_gap.meaning: Metaethics.Sig.ObjectiveTruth φ says that the sentence φ is true independently of anyone's attitudes or conventions. It is a supplied predicate on the sentences of the metaethics comparison signature.
examples: On a moral realist's view, 'gratuitous cruelty is wrong' would be objectively true.
exclusions: Truth relative to an agent's attitudes or a community's conventions.
Any reduction of the predicate to a truth-plus-attitude criterion: the analyst calibrations are recorded separately in DISAMB-OBJECTIVE-TRUTH-CALIBRATIONS.
open_obligations: The weakest objective-implies-truth proposition is recorded separately and not adopted as every sense of objectivity.
No formalization candidate: defining it by one calibration would choose among recorded rivals.
